settings.title: Protecting every surface of those who go deep.

settings.text:
The beauty of the outdoors lies in its grand intentional design. We believe that every part has its purpose. Each element built perfectly to thrive. And it's within this beauty, we find our potential to protect.

Harnessing the elements to create what was thought impossible. We can learn from nature's resolve. Grow from it. Safeguard it. And when we stop mastering, and start channeling the outdoors, we unlock a new kind of performance in skincare. We reach our best where we truly belong.

In this stillness, we become freaks of nature.
NATURE'S BEAUTY INSPIRES US TO PUSH THE LIMITS ON SUSTAINABILITY

settings.title: NATURE'S BEAUTY INSPIRES US TO PUSH THE LIMITS ON SUSTAINABILITY

settings.text: We are committed to protecting the beauty of the outdoors in every way we can. We make small improvements but with an aim to have a big impact. We take pride in our products, how we formulate them and how we manufacture them but acknowledge we can always do better. We will continue to align ourselves with organizations that align with our values and help us make a larger impact.

settings.title: Made with bio-based ingredients
settings.description: We're relentless about sourcing minerals, bio-actives and natural ingredients that are well-researched, standardized, and efficacious because our priority is your skin, your wellbeing and that of mother nature.

settings.title: 100% ocean-bound plastic
settings.description: Our bottles are made of 100% recycled plastic sourced from our partner, Oceanworks®. This material is entirely traceable and written on a digital ledger.

settings.title: Removing 25,000 pounds of plastic
settings.description: Thanks to our work with Impac+ by Oceanworks®, it is our aim to remove over 25,000 pounds of plastic from our oceans.

settings.text:
Nature can teach us a lot. For one, how to thrive in the elements. 
With nature's freaks as our inspiration and science as our compass, we are reimagining everyday skin health for the outdoors.

Unlock your own Superhuman Skin with Freaks of Nature™, so you can thrive out there too.
settings.author: Kelly Slater
settings.description: Co-Founder, Professional Surfer, 11x WSL World Champion

Made with bio-based ingredients

We're relentless about sourcing minerals, bio-actives and natural ingredients that are well-researched, standardized, and efficacious because our priority is your skin, your wellbeing and that of mother nature.

First 100% ocean-bound plastic pump

Our bottles are an engineering feat as it's the first ever airless pump made of 100% recycled plastic sourced from our partner, Oceanworks®. This material is entirely traceable and written on a digital ledger.

Removing 40.000 pounds of plastic

Thanks to our work with Impac+ by Oceanworks®, it is our aim to remove an additional 40,000 pounds of plastic from coastal areas by April 22, 2025 (Earth Day).
